seo.title: Totally Random... Funny Fortunes
seo.description: Yoto Says: Discover your fate! With over 100 hilariously wise and random responses, what will your future hold today? Step right up! Welcome, brave fortune seekers! Peer into the swirling mists with the one and only Madame Oodlepoof, the fortune teller who loves to surprise, delight, and maybe even make you laugh!Through the magic of your Yoto player, you can take a peek into your future with over 100 silly and sweet fortunes. Whenever you’re feeling curious, just press the button and Madame Oodlepoof will reveal a fabulous, funny, and totally random fortune just for you.Could there be a party in your future? Or might you discover where the vegetables on your dinner plate have gone? Open your imaginations and find out!PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed. Tracks included: Introduction, 1a_Music_Sting_Long_Funny_Fortunes_CrystalBall_GIF.wav, 1_Funny_Fortunes_Response.wav, 2_Funny_Fortunes_Outro.wav, 3a_Music_Sting_Long_Funny_Fortunes_ThoughtBubble_GIF.wav and more.

Whenever you’re feeling curious, just press the button and Madame Oodlepoof will reveal a fabulous, funny, and totally random fortune just for you.Could there be a party in your future?
